exercises.instructionEn: Present Simple - Form. Affirmative: I work, he works. Negative: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. Interrogative: Do I work? Does he work?
exercises.instructionUz: Hozirgi oddiy zamon - Shakli. Tasdiq: I work, he works. Inkor: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. So'roq: Do I work? Does he work?
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE - ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TASDIQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I / you / we / they  WORK
  he / she / it        WORKS

  ⚠ 3-shaxs birlikda -S / -ES.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I / you / we / they  DON'T work
  he / she / it        DOESN'T work

  ⚠ Uzun: do not / does not.
  ⚠ 'doesn't' dan keyin fe'lda -S
  YO'Q: 'he doesn't work' ('works'
  emas!).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO'ROQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DO I / you / we / they work?
  DOES he / she / it work?

  ⚠ 'Does he like tennis?' - 'likes'
  emas!


⚠ 'A SUBJECT':

  = ega.


⚠ 'THIRD PERSON SINGULAR':

  = 3-shaxs birlik (he, she, it).


⚠ 'THE MAIN VERB':

  = asosiy fe'l.

tasks.en: Present Simple - Form. Affirmative: I work, he works. Negative: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. Interrogative: Do I work? Does he work?
tasks.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamon - Shakli. Tasdiq: I work, he works. Inkor: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. So'roq: Do I work? Does he work?

tasks.en: We form the present simple with the subject (noun or personal pronoun) and the verb. The third person singular takes -s or -es in the affirmative.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonni ega (ot yoki kishilik olmoshi) va fe'l bilan yasaymiz. Tasdiqda 3-shaxs birlik -s yoki -es oladi.

tasks.en: Negative: We use subject + don't + main verb in all persons except the third person singular. We use subject + doesn't + main verb in this person. I don't play, he doesn't play.
tasks.uz: Inkor: 3-shaxs birlikdan tashqari barcha shaxslarda ega + don't + asosiy fe'l. 3-shaxs birlikda ega + doesn't + asosiy fe'l. I don't play, he doesn't play.

tasks.en: Interrogative: We use do + subject + verb in all persons except for the third person singular. We use does + subject + verb in this person. Do you like football? Does he like tennis?
tasks.uz: So'roq: 3-shaxs birlikdan tashqari barcha shaxslarda do + ega + fe'l. 3-shaxs birlikda does + ega + fe'l. Do you like football? Does he like tennis?

exercises.explanationUz:
3-ShAXS BIRLIK IMLOSI:

  1 Ko'p fe'llar → -S:
    work → works
  2 -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan
    tugasa → -ES:
    go → goes, watch → watches,
    kiss → kisses, wash → washes,
    fix → fixes
  3 undosh + y → -y tushib -IES:
    fly → flies, study → studies
  4 unli + y → -S:
    play → plays, buy → buys


⚠ 'A CONSONANT':

  = undosh harf.


⚠ 'A VOWEL':

  = unli harf (a, e, i, o, u).

tasks.en: Spelling: 3rd person singular affirmative.
tasks.uz: Imlo: 3-shaxs birlik tasdiq.

tasks.en: Most verbs take -s in the third person singular. I work - he works
tasks.uz: Ko'p fe'llar 3-shaxs birlikda -s oladi. I work - he works

tasks.en: Verbs ending in -ss, -sh, -ch, -x or -o take -es. I go - he goes
tasks.uz: -ss, -sh, -ch, -x yoki -o bilan tugagan fe'llar -es oladi. I go - he goes

tasks.en: Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop -y and take -ies. I fly - he flies
tasks.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe'llar -y ni tashlab -ies oladi. I fly - he flies

tasks.en: Verbs ending in a vowel + y take -s. I play - he plays
tasks.uz: Unli + y bilan tugagan fe'llar -s oladi. I play - he plays

exercises.instructionEn: Pronunciation: -s or -es in the third person singular.
exercises.explanationUz:
-S / -ES TALAFFUZI:

  /s/ - jarangsiz undoshdan keyin
    (/f/, /k/, /p/, /t/):
    sits /sɪts/, works /wɜːks/,
    laughs /lɑːfs/, stops /stɒps/

  /ɪz/ - shivirlovchi tovushdan
    keyin (/s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/,
    /z/):
    watches /ˈwɒtʃɪz/, washes,
    kisses, changes, uses

  /z/ - boshqa barcha tovushlardan
    keyin (jarangli undosh, unli):
    plays /pleɪz/, goes /ɡəʊz/,
    runs /rʌnz/, lives /lɪvz/


⚠ Bu qoida OTLARNING KO'PLIGIGA
ham tegishli: cats /s/, dogs /z/,
buses /ɪz/.

tasks.en: Pronunciation: -s or -es in the third person singular.
tasks.uz: Talaffuz: 3-shaxs birlikda -s yoki -es.

tasks.en: /s/ with verbs ending in /f/, /k/, /p/ or /t/ sounds. he sits
tasks.uz: /s/ - /f/, /k/, /p/ yoki /t/ tovushlari bilan tugagan fe'llarda. he sits

tasks.en: /ɪz/ with verbs ending in /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ or /z/ sounds. he watches
tasks.uz: /ɪz/ - /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ yoki /z/ tovushlari bilan tugagan fe'llarda. he watches

tasks.en: /z/ with verbs ending in all other sounds. he plays
tasks.uz: /z/ - boshqa barcha tovushlar bilan tugagan fe'llarda. he plays

exercises.instructionEn: Use. We use the present simple for daily routines, repeated actions or habits, and permanent states. Time expressions: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Short answers: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi. Hozirgi oddiy zamonni kundalik odatlar, takrorlanuvchi ishlar va doimiy holatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Vaqt iboralari: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE - IShLATILIShI:

  1 KUNDALIK ODATLAR, takrorlanuvchi
    ishlar:
    'I GET UP at seven every day.'
  2 DOIMIY HOLATLAR:
    'I LIVE in London.'


VAQT IBORALARI:

  every hour/day/week/month/
    summer/year = har soat/kun/
    hafta/oy/yoz/yil
  usually = odatda
  always = har doim
  every morning/evening = har
    ertalab/kechqurun
  in the morning/afternoon/evening
    = ertalab/tushdan keyin/
    kechqurun
  at night = kechasi

  ⚠ 'IN the morning' lekin 'AT
  night'!


QISQA JAVOBLAR:

  Do you ...? → Yes, I do. / No,
    I don't.
  Does he/she/it ...? → Yes, he
    does. / No, he doesn't.
  Do they ...? → Yes, they do. /
    No, they don't.

  ⚠ Qisqa javobda ASOSIY FE'L
  takrorlanmaydi: 'Yes, I do' ('Yes,
  I like' EMAS).


⚠ 'A ROUTINE':

  = kundalik tartib.


⚠ 'A HABIT':

  = odat.


⚠ 'PERMANENT':

  = doimiy.

tasks.en: Use. We use the present simple for daily routines, repeated actions or habits, and permanent states. Time expressions: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Short answers: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
tasks.uz: Ishlatilishi. Hozirgi oddiy zamonni kundalik odatlar, takrorlanuvchi ishlar va doimiy holatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Vaqt iboralari: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

tasks.en: We use the present simple for daily routines, repeated actions or habits. I get up at seven every day.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonni kundalik tartib, takrorlanuvchi ishlar yoki odatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Men har kuni yettida turaman.

tasks.en: We use the present simple for permanent states. I live in London.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonni doimiy holatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Men Londonda yashayman.

tasks.en: Time expressions: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year etc, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night etc.
tasks.uz: Vaqt iboralari: har soat/kun/hafta/oy/yoz/yil, odatda, har doim, har ertalab/kechqurun/tushdan keyin/kecha, ertalab/tushdan keyin/kechqurun, kechasi.

tasks.en: In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and do/don't or does/doesn't. Do you ...? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Does he ...? - Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
tasks.uz: Qisqa javoblarda 'Yes' yoki 'No', ega olmoshi va do/don't yoki does/doesn't ishlatamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Present Continuous (to be + verb -ing). Affirmative: I'm playing, he's playing. Interrogative: Am I playing? Is he playing? Negative: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
exercises.instructionUz: Hozirgi davomli zamon (to be + fe'l -ing). Tasdiq: I'm playing, he's playing. So'roq: Am I playing? Is he playing? Inkor: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. Hozirgi davomli zamonni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning asosiy shakliga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS - ShAKLI.

  BE (am/is/are) + FE'L-ING


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TASDIQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I'm playing
  you're / we're / they're playing
  he's / she's / it's playing


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO'ROQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Am I playing?
  Are you / we / they playing?
  Is he / she / it playing?

  ⚠ 'be' oldinga chiqadi.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I'm not playing
  you aren't / we aren't playing
  he isn't / she isn't playing


⚠ 'THE BASE FORM':

  = fe'lning asosiy shakli (play,
  go).

tasks.en: Present Continuous (to be + verb -ing). Affirmative: I'm playing, he's playing. Interrogative: Am I playing? Is he playing? Negative: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi davomli zamon (to be + fe'l -ing). Tasdiq: I'm playing, he's playing. So'roq: Am I playing? Is he playing? Inkor: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. Hozirgi davomli zamonni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning asosiy shakliga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz.

tasks.en: Affirmative: I'm playing, you're playing, he's/she's/it's playing, we're/they're playing.
tasks.uz: Tasdiq: I'm playing, you're playing, he's/she's/it's playing, we're/they're playing.

tasks.en: Interrogative: Am I playing? Are you playing? Is he/she/it playing? Are we/they playing?
tasks.uz: So'roq: Am I playing? Are you playing? Is he/she/it playing? Are we/they playing?

tasks.en: Negative: I'm not playing, you aren't playing, he/she/it isn't playing, we/they aren't playing.
tasks.uz: Inkor: I'm not playing, you aren't playing, he/she/it isn't playing, we/they aren't playing.

tasks.en: We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi davomli zamonni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning asosiy shakliga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Use. Time expressions: now, at the moment, at present. Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi. Vaqt iboralari: now, at the moment, at present. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS - IShLATILIShI:

  1 HOZIR, gapirish paytida
    bo'layotgan ish:
    "I'm playing tennis NOW."
  2 Gapirish vaqti ATROFIDA
    bo'layotgan ish (aynan hozir
    emas):
    "We're looking for a flat at the
     moment."
  3 YAQIN KELAJAKDAGI ANIQ REJA:
    "I'm seeing John tomorrow."


VAQT IBORALARI:
  now = hozir
  at the moment = ayni paytda
  at present = hozirda


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Are you ...? → Yes, I am. / No,
    I'm not.
  Is he ...? → Yes, he is. / No, he
    isn't.
  Are they ...? → Yes, they are. /
    No, they aren't.

  ⚠ -ING fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'Yes,
  I am' ('Yes, I am playing' EMAS).
  ⚠ 'Yes, I'm' - XATO! Qisqa
  ijobiy javobda qisqartma yo'q.


⚠ 'A FIXED ARRANGEMENT':

  = aniq kelishilgan reja.


⚠ 'A FLAT':

  = kvartira (BrE).

tasks.en: Use. Time expressions: now, at the moment, at present. Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
tasks.uz: Ishlatilishi. Vaqt iboralari: now, at the moment, at present. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.

tasks.en: Actions happening now, at the moment of speaking. I'm playing tennis now.
tasks.uz: Hozir, gapirish paytida bo'layotgan ishlar. Men hozir tennis o'ynayapman.

tasks.en: Actions happening around the time of speaking. We're looking for a flat at the moment.
tasks.uz: Gapirish vaqti atrofida bo'layotgan ishlar. Biz ayni paytda kvartira qidiryapmiz.

tasks.en: Fixed arrangements in the near future. I'm seeing John tomorrow.
tasks.uz: Yaqin kelajakdagi aniq rejalar. Men ertaga John bilan uchrashaman.

tasks.en: In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and the verb "to be" in the correct form. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.
tasks.uz: Qisqa javoblarda 'Yes' yoki 'No', ega olmoshi va 'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shaklini ishlatamiz. -ing li asosiy fe'lni takrorlamaymiz.

sections.title: Unit 2 - Adverbs of Frequency; Past Simple

exercises.instructionEn: Adverbs of frequency, always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually come before the main verb, but after the auxiliary verb (do, does etc) and the verb to be. They tell us how often something happens.
exercises.instructionUz: Takrorlanish ravishlari - always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually - asosiy fe'ldan oldin, lekin yordamchi fe'l (do, does va h.k.) va 'to be' fe'lidan keyin keladi. Ular biror narsa qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishini bildiradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI:

  always = har doim (100%)
  usually = odatda
  often = tez-tez
  sometimes = ba'zan
  rarely = kamdan-kam (= not often)
  never = hech qachon (0%)


O'RNI:

  1 ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
    'I NEVER get up early.'
    'He RARELY goes to the zoo.'
    'She SOMETIMES has a sandwich.'
  2 YoRDAMChI FE'LDAN KEYIN:
    'Do you OFTEN walk to work?'
  3 'BE' DAN KEYIN:
    'Mum IS USUALLY home by four.'
    'He IS ALWAYS late for work.'

  ⚠ 'He always is late' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'never' bilan inkor
  ishlatilmaydi: "I don't never" ✗.


⚠ 'AN AUXILIARY VERB':

  = yordamchi fe'l (do, does, did,
  have, will ...).

tasks.en: Adverbs of frequency, always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually come before the main verb, but after the auxiliary verb (do, does etc) and the verb to be. They tell us how often something happens.
tasks.uz: Takrorlanish ravishlari - always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually - asosiy fe'ldan oldin, lekin yordamchi fe'l (do, does va h.k.) va 'to be' fe'lidan keyin keladi. Ular biror narsa qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishini bildiradi.

tasks.en: Adverbs of frequency come before the main verb: I never get up early on Sundays. He rarely goes to the zoo. (= not often) She sometimes has a sandwich for lunch.
tasks.uz: Takrorlanish ravishlari asosiy fe'ldan oldin keladi: Men yakshanba kunlari hech qachon erta turmayman. U kamdan-kam hayvonot bog'iga boradi. U ba'zan tushlikka sendvich yeydi.

tasks.en: But after the auxiliary verb: Do you often walk to work?
tasks.uz: Lekin yordamchi fe'ldan keyin: Siz tez-tez ishga piyoda borasizmi?

tasks.en: And after the verb to be: Mum is usually home by four. He is always late for work.
tasks.uz: Va 'to be' fe'lidan keyin: Onam odatda to'rtgacha uyda bo'ladi. U har doim ishga kech qoladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Past Simple: regular verbs. Affirmative: I worked. Interrogative: Did I work? Negative: I didn't work.
exercises.instructionUz: O'tgan oddiy zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar. Tasdiq: I worked. So'roq: Did I work? Inkor: I didn't work.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE - ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TASDIQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  To'g'ri fe'llar: FE'L + -ED
    work → worked (HAMMA shaxsda
    bir xil!)
  Noto'g'ri fe'llar: 2-shakl
    see → saw, go → went
    (ro'yxat 128-betda)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DIDN'T + ASOSIY ShAKL
  'I didn't WORK yesterday.'
  'I didn't SEE Tom.' ('didn't saw'
   EMAS!)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO'ROQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DID + EGA + ASOSIY ShAKL
  'Did he WORK yesterday?'
  'Did you SEE Tom?' ('Did you saw'
   EMAS!)


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Did you call me? → Yes, I DID.
  Did he tell you? → No, he DIDN'T.


⚠ 'REGULAR' / 'IRREGULAR':

  = to'g'ri / noto'g'ri (fe'l).

tasks.en: Past Simple: regular verbs. Affirmative: I worked. Interrogative: Did I work? Negative: I didn't work.
tasks.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar. Tasdiq: I worked. So'roq: Did I work? Inkor: I didn't work.

tasks.en: We form the affirmative of most regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. I work - I worked. Other verbs have irregular affirmative forms. I see - I saw (see list of irregular verbs on p. 128)
tasks.uz: Ko'p to'g'ri fe'llarning tasdiq shaklini fe'lga -ed qo'shib yasaymiz. I work - I worked. Boshqa fe'llar noto'g'ri tasdiq shakliga ega. I see - I saw (noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati 128-betda)

tasks.en: We form the negative of past simple with didn't + base form of the verb. I didn't work yesterday, I didn't see Tom yesterday.
tasks.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamon inkorini didn't + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. Kecha ishlamadim, kecha Tomni ko'rmadim.

tasks.en: We form the interrogative of past simple with Did + personal subject pronoun + base form of the verb. Did he work yesterday? Did you see Tom yesterday?
tasks.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamon so'rog'ini Did + ega olmoshi + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. U kecha ishladimi? Kecha Tomni ko'rdingizmi?

tasks.en: We form positive short answers with did and negative short answers with didn't. Did you call me? Yes, I did. Did he tell you? No, he didn't.
tasks.uz: Ijobiy qisqa javoblarni did, inkor qisqa javoblarni didn't bilan yasaymiz. Menga qo'ng'iroq qildingmi? Ha. U senga aytdimi? Yo'q.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I get up at seven every day. She gets up at eight.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men har kuni yettida turaman. U sakkizda turadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't play tennis. He doesn't play football.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men tennis o'ynamayman. U futbol o'ynamaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Does he like tennis? - Yes, he does.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + RAVISh + FE'L. / EGA + be + RAVISh.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I never get up early. He is always late.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men hech qachon erta turmayman. U har doim kech qoladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + FE'L-ED / didn't + FE'L. Did + EGA + FE'L?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I worked yesterday. I didn't see Tom. Did you call me?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha ishladim. Tomni ko'rmadim. Menga qo'ng'iroq qildingmi?
